age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 40 years Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

qualification.details: Computer Programmer: Bachelor's degree in Science with training in Computer Programming and Operation. Minimum three years' experience in Computer Programming and Operation, including at least one year's experience of working in a scientific institution. Junior Assistant: Intermediate (12th) with Diploma in Computer Operation (DOEACC Society's CCC certificate or equivalent) and Hindi/English typing speed of at least 25/30 words per minute respectively. Computer Operator: Graduate with training in Computer Operation and Programming. EPABX Operator: Graduate with training in EPABX and Post & Telegraph Department training. Accountant: Graduate degree in Commerce with Accountancy. Two years' experience of working in any Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous / Public Sector Undertaking. Private Secretary to the Director General: Bachelor's degree in any subject from a recognized University/College, and Hindi and English shorthand with typing speed of at least 25/30 words per minute. Stenographer: Intermediate (12th) with Hindi shorthand speed of 80 words per minute and typing speed of 25 words per minute. Knowledge of computers is required, along with a CCC certificate. Accounts Clerk: Graduate with a Bachelor's degree in Commerce, along with knowledge of computer applications and accounting.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the UPCAR Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of UPCAR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UPCAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the UPCAR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPCAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for various posts in the Uttar Pradesh Council of Agricultural Research (UPCAR) recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the UPCAR posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years as of the specified cut-off date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Unreserved category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved (UR) and Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category candidates is ₹570, which includes the application fee and processing charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for UPCAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will consist of two stages: Tier-I, an OMR Based Written Test, followed by Tier-II, a Trade/Skill/Computer Proficiency Test.

faq.question: Q6. What is the starting date for online applications?
faq.answer: The online application process for UPCAR Recruitment 2026 will commence on 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Assistant post, candidates need to have passed Intermediate (12th) with a Diploma in Computer Operation and possess a typing speed of at least 25/30 words per minute in Hindi/English respectively.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. However, it is advisable to check the detailed notification for any such clauses.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The Accountant post offers a salary in the pay scale of ₹ 9300-34800 with a Grade Pay of ₹ 4200/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
